purpose: Long-horizon stress test on the existing 30-symbol US universe

data.split_cleanup: common-factor overnight split detection; pre-split OHLCV back-adjusted

strategy.Track_B: production defaults frozen; no long-horizon tuning
strategy.management: TP1 30% => BE; TP2 30% => TP1; runner 40% confirmed 4H pivot

conservative_5r_cap.method: At most five simultaneous 1R positions; does not credit intratrade risk reduction.

limitations: Current-universe test is survivorship-biased by construction and is a regime stress test, not pristine OOS.
